findings.text: follow-on: node_tmp_runtime_paths() is filtered by path.exists() at composition, so a runtime path the launch must write but which is absent when the fence is composed composes no writable grant; /tmp/.codex is a directory codex's sandbox creates lazily, so on a node where it does not yet exist the grant this change promises is silently absent.
